Factor:
\[
7632=2^4\cdot 3^2\cdot 53.
\]
The two-digit factor possibilities are \(12,16,18,24,36,48,53,72\), giving three-digit cofactors:
\[
636,477,424,318,212,159,144,106.
\]
Since \(7632\) uses digits \(2,3,6,7\), the factors must use digits \(1,4,5,8,9\). Only
\[
159\times 48=7632
\]
works. Thus \(abc=159\), so \(b=5\).

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
